description: Apparently Roman period rings, brooches, and metalwork were discovered in the waters of the spring during late 19th CE excavations to build a public swimming bath at Toddler's Cove, Westgate. They were associated with a Roman timber-built structure that may have been a mill, but a shrine interpretation has also been suggested.
